preconditions.description: The length of the genome n must be between 4 and 255 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '===' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in 'ACGT' for c in stdout) and stdout.count('A') == stdout.count('C') == stdout.count('G') == stdout.count('T'))
postconditions.description: If decoding is possible, stdout must be a string of length n with equal counts of 'A', 'C', 'G', and 'T'; otherwise, it must be '==='.
